added_lines: Pope Leo’s Prayer Intention Nov 2026 This month, Pope Leo XIV invites us to pray for the proper use of wealth. Let us pray for the proper use of wealth, that not succumbing to the temptation of selfishness, it may always be put at the service the common good and solidarity of those who have less. With a friendly crowd and proceeds helping to keep this facility running, it is the perfect way to support your community while having fun. See you there! Donations of Food Items for the Needy. Gurranabraher parish is one of the few parishes in the city that makes a seri ous effort to come to the aid of its needy especially at Christmas time. Also, if you know families that could benefit from some extra food this Christmas , please let us know. Church needs to Recover the Practice of Eucharistic Devotion. “Whenever worship is no longer done, wherever it is not a priority to payho nour to God, human realities can make no headway. Adoration is not a luxury buta necessity, because when people cease to adore God, they begin to worship themselves through exalting pleasure, power, and material goods. Failing to adore God, they begin to serve mammon (Mt 6:24) — and once they begin to serve mammon, they forget who they are. Without the Creator, the creature disappears…” (Pope Benedict XVI - 2008).

Prayer to Christ the King Lord, Jesus Christ, Our Sovereign King The beginning and end of all things, You have made your Church to be a people that bears witness to the goodness and beauty of your kingdom. By your Holy Spirit, you have united us as one body, called to live as one family of God. Fill our hearts with your grace, that we would be close to you by being close to the vulnerable and margi nalized. Give us the patience to share one another’s burdens, and give us the courage to a lways be friends of the truth. May we remain with you always. Amen Prayer for World Youth Day which is celebrated this Sunday, 22nd November Loving Lord of all young people, we thank you for inviting us into your love and mercy. Our Father, we entrust ourselves to you. May young people ev erywhere be comforted in the embrace of your Church, and come to share deeply i n the joy of communion and unity. Lord Jesus Christ, you overcome the world, both now and forever. May all people discover the hope that lies in your call to take courage, realizing that the cross of love and forgiveness is the true victory over the world. O Holy Spirit, Flame of Love, by your wondrous hand you have sown the seeds of faith in our lives. Kindle the Ňame of the saints and martyrs’ faith in our hearts, making us into disciples who live out the gospel of peace, love, and truth. Lord, we pray that on this World Youth Day we may listen to each other, discer n your will, and become a synodal Church, walking together with all of God’s people. Amen . Sunday 15th November Ballylucra Cemetery: 1.00pm. Thank You A sincere word of thanks to all those who helped and were involved in any way with our recent Remembrance Mass which took place on 6th November in the Sacred Heart Church.
Thanks also to those who took part in the blessing of graves in the various cemeteries around the parish.
Parish Envelopes If you use the envelope system for the various church collections, your box of envelopes for 2027 is now available from the Parish Office.
A sincere word of thanks to all who support the parish financially whether it is through the envelope system, by placing cash in the collection baskets, and by periodic or annual contributions.
Thanks also to those who have signed up for the envelope system following the recent appeal at the weekend Masses.

For your information, the offertory collection at the weekend Masses and on the various church holidays goes towards the financial upkeep of the parish on a day-to-day, week- to-week paying the bills, just like any household.
Second Collection This Youth Ministry special collection will be taken up at all Masses this weekend.
It is important for us to encourage and support our young people in every way we can so that they can become involved in their local parish.
This collection directly supports the work of Sheila Kelleher, our Diocesan Youth Ministry Coordinator, and the many volunteers dedicated to nurturing faith among our youth.
Please be as generous as you can as we cannot do this without your support.
Investing in our young people is vital for the future of the Church.

Forever Loved, Forever Cherished Farranree parish will host a special Service of Remembrance for babies and infants lost during pregnancy or at birth down through the years on Friday, 27th November, at 7.00pm in the Church of the Resurrection, Knockpogue Avenue, Farranree, Cork T23 NV97. Anyone who has experienced the heartache of the loss of an infant or baby, no matter how is welcome to this service as we remember your precious child and honouring their memory in quiet ritual and prayer.
